_comment: Broad on purpose, and across two aspects. The core is what makes an Age scorched at all -- burning sun, and heat; the pool is what makes this scorched Age different from the last. `molten` in the query is what pulls its sky and its rock toward fire without any of it being named here. Its motes are ash and only ash: embers and flames belong to the inferno phenomenon, because they are the warning that an Age is burning *now* and a warning that also appears elsewhere is not one. Ash is the past tense, and is what a scorched Age has.
